description:
Get details about apartments at Landhaus Prägant, Bad Kleinkirchheim, Austria.

Returns size, bedrooms, amenities, highlights, cleaning fees.
Apartment facts as maintained on praegant.net (synced hourly).

This is the data-only version — for a visual apartment gallery card, call
render_apartment_gallery() with the same arguments after reviewing this result.

Args:
    name: Apartment name or number (e.g. '11', '15', '#12', 'all').
          Leave empty to show all apartments.
    language: "de" (default) or "en" — match the conversation language.
name: get_apartment_details
title: Get Apartment Details
